extra_brief:
Egypt gas specifics:
- Research in ARABIC as well as English. Decisive sources are usually Arabic: petroleum.gov.eg, egas.com.eg, gasco.com.eg, youm7.com, elwatannews.com, almalnews.com, egyptoil-gas.com (bilingual).
- Key entities: EGAS, GASCO (Egyptian Natural Gas Co.), Petrobel, IEOC/Eni, BAPETCO, Rashpetco, Sonker (Ain Sokhna LNG/LPG), SUMED / Arab Petroleum Pipelines Co.
- EVERY row in this scope was added by researcher 'NA' (Nagwa) and NONE has been research-audited before. Many were identified VISUALLY off the GASCO national-grid MAP on printed p.35 of the EGAS Annual Report 2018 — so a full-text search of that report MISSING the pipeline is NOT evidence the citation is bad. A report cited for a pipeline is not 'unsupported' until its MAPS have been read, not just its text. Say explicitly which test you applied.
- Researcher initials 'NA' are a real code, not a missing value.
- Wikipedia IS citable (policy confirmed 2026-08-27). gem.wiki is NEVER a source, in any field.
- BANNED absolutely: abarrelfull.wikidot.com / abarrelfull.co.uk. Never cite, never use as corroboration. If a value appears only there, the value is UNSOURCED; chase its primary source.
- A 403 / geo-block / TLS failure / timeout is a BLOCK, not a deletion. Only a confirmed 404 or 410 means a page is gone. Never report a blocked page as dead.
- The harvested wiki-citation pool is a WORKLIST, not a lookup table: do not stop at the first sufficient source. Report how many harvested citations you actually opened.
- Beware SOFT 404s: some sites return HTTP 200 with a shell page for any slug. If a page 200s but carries no article, say so; prove it by fetching a nonsense sibling slug and diffing body size.
- 'P.S.' in these row names means pressure station.

DUPLICATE / IDENTITY WATCHLIST (questions to answer with sources, not conclusions to confirm):
- The Trans-Sinai family: P8013 'Trans Sinai Gas Pipeline I', P8041 + P8044 'Abr Sina(i) Gas Pipeline I' (two segments). 'Abr Sinai' (عبر سيناء) IS Arabic for 'Trans-Sinai'. Are the English and Arabic names two entries for one system? NOTE also that P8008/P8009 ('Abr Sinai II') and P8055 ('Trans-Sinai II') exist OUTSIDE this scope and raise the same question at the II level.
- P8072 'Kima Aswan Industrial' (4 km) vs P8073 'Aswan-Kima' (20 km) — two segments of one feed to the KIMA fertilizer complex, or one line entered twice at different lengths?
- P8031 'Ameriya Cement-Borg El Arab' vs P8032 'Ameriya-Dahshour': prior GEM work established there are TWO DISTINCT 'Ameriya' nodes ~10.2 km apart near Alexandria. Establish which node each row uses.
- P8011 'Atsa Gas Pipeline' vs P8012 'Old Fayoum Gas Pipeline' — both Fayoum-area; related?
- P8010 'Gamasa-Edku' vs P8027 'Damietta-Idku' — Edku and Idku are the same place (الإدكو). Check.
- P8021 'Kuraimat- Al Tebbin' vs P8014 'Zaafarana-Kuraimat' — segments of one Suez-to-Cairo trunk?
A same-name pair with DIFFERENT diameters is usually two real parallel lines, not a duplicate. A same-name pair with the same diameter AND the same length is the suspicious case.
